registry_server.description: Zendesk MCP for Webflow asset reviewer ticket search, comments, and status workflows

dify_studio_steps: Create an HTTP MCP server card with server ID webflow-zendesk.
Classify zendesk_search_* and zendesk_get_* tools as read-only.
Classify zendesk_add_ticket_comment, zendesk_update_ticket_status, and zendesk_add_internal_note as write tools requiring reviewer confirmation.
Keep Webflow App Review MCP registered alongside this server. Agents choose Zendesk for ticket conversation/status state and Webflow App Review MCP for Airtable review/governance state.
Transcribe every discovered tool into config/dify/inventory.json with risk classification.
Run pnpm dify:inventory:generate and pnpm dify:coverage:generate.
notes: This intake artifact is not a Dify inventory entry.
Do not paste the inventory fragment until Dify Studio has discovered tools and each tool is classified.
Keep secret values in Infisical only; this artifact stores references, not values.
Zendesk service auth should also live under the same Infisical path, using WEBFLOW_ZENDESK_EMAIL plus WEBFLOW_ZENDESK_API_TOKEN, WEBFLOW_ZENDESK_PASSWORD, or WEBFLOW_ZENDESK_OAUTH_TOKEN.
The Zendesk MCP and Webflow App Review MCP are both first-class reviewer options; route based on whether the current task depends on Zendesk ticket state or Airtable app-review/governance state.
Use https://webflow2579.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/1147219 as a write-permission validation target when credentials are configured and the operator approves the exact comment/status update.
